claims.text: SAP is making Joule Work more interoperable with Microsoft Work IQ to close the gap between where work happens and where business runs.
SAP Business Data Cloud Connect for Microsoft Fabric provides bidirectional, zero-copy data integration to create a unified data foundation across SAP and Microsoft environments.
The agent gateway and open A2A protocol let agents built with Microsoft Copilot Studio delegate SAP work directly to Joule Agents with security and policies preserved.
SAP AI Agent Hub gives administrators telemetry and lifecycle visibility across SAP, Microsoft, and third-party agents to observe, govern, and measure agent activity.

evidence.quote: Joule Work even more interoperable by taking advantage of the latest capabilities in Microsoft Work IQ, announced at Microsoft Ignite.
SAP Business Data Cloud Connect for Microsoft Fabric enables a unified data foundation across SAP and Microsoft environments through bidirectional, zero-copy data integration.
With the release earlier this month of the agent gateway and the open A2A protocol, agents built with Microsoft Copilot Studio can delegate SAP-specific work directly to Joule Agents
SAP AI Agent Hub, part of SAP Business AI Platform, gives organizations telemetry and lifecycle visibility across SAP, Microsoft, and third-party agents as they multiply across environments.
